Property tax deadlines lead to increased collections

Municipal corporations in India have seen significant property tax collections as deadlines approach. In Raipur, the corporation collected ₹1.55 crore in a single day, while Sonipat corporation gathered ₹35 lakh. These collections were boosted by incentives such as 100% interest waivers on property tax, which ended on the same day.
